about.heading: Why INOK
body: INOK stands for Idhu Namme Oru Kedai, Tamil for "this is our shop". Every participant came with a business of their own, and every lesson was about growing it.

Small businesses in the Malaysian Indian community often have strong products but little time or support to take them online. INOK was designed to change that: practical digital-marketing skills, taught in person, then applied to each participant's own business with a mentor alongside.

The 2024 Program Pensijilan Digital Marketing Strategist was delivered by GET Academy under a programme funded by MITRA (Malaysian Indian Community Transformation Unit), with certification through SEGi University.
